quality.finding: Exact-SHA runner.run_once builds anata_latest.json from a previously read archive snapshot and later replaces it without a snapshot-generation compare. At equal as_of_ms, newer B with rowB can publish before delayed older A, which then overwrites B. Atomic JSON visibility is tested, but causally monotonic single-handoff publication is not. Neither as_of_ms alone nor publication completion order proves snapshot freshness.
quality.test_oracle: Authorized disposable exact-SHA checkout: no-network fixed-T two-process Event-gated regression pauses A before anata_latest.json replace, appends valid PIT rowB, lets B publish, then releases A. Assert final file preserves rowB source_evidence.clock_provenance.source_record_id; both child exitcodes zero; include negative controls for equal-T and completion-order-only guards; record red/green, logs and overlay hash. Do not require three-file transactional semantics.
